Log today's Group 1 dose live. Stock decreases to 7.
Delete Group 2's Nov 14 completed record, confirming Delete. Reopen medicine: stock stays 7.
Delete the live dose and Group 2's Nov 13 completed record, confirming each. Reopen medicine: still 7 / 10 tablets.
